# kihera-trace — generated mirror, do not edit here

Netlify deploys this repo to **trace.kihera-farms.com**. Every file is a
copy synced from **`web/trace/` in `Dii-winga/kihera-app`**, which is the
source of truth. Edits made directly here are overwritten on the next
sync — change the page in kihera-app instead.

See `web/trace/README.md` and `docs/domains/traceability.md` in kihera-app.
